verdict: Aptiv's sales rose 2% to a record $3.2B as non-automotive demand offset flat car production, and it swung to a $194M profit from a loss a year ago, when a $648M goodwill charge hit results.

kpis.label: Net sales
kpis.note: A record quarter, +2% vs a year ago

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP diluted)
kpis.note: From continuing operations; adjusted EPS was $1.42

kpis.label: Net income
kpis.note: Vs a $352M loss a year ago

segments.name: Engineered Components
segments.note: Connectors, cable management and components — increasingly sold beyond cars, into industry, aerospace and data centers.

segments.name: Intelligent Systems
segments.note: Software, sensing and compute for vehicle safety and automation. Segment sales were $1,402M before $38M of eliminations and other items.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Running and selling — down from $333M a year ago on cost discipline.

opex.name: Amortization
opex.note: Writing down acquired technology and customer relationships over time (non-cash); it includes impairment charges this quarter.

opex.name: Restructuring
opex.note: Costs of footprint and workforce actions.

otherDetail: Interest expense of $59M, partly offset by a $19M gain on equity-method transactions and $5M of other income; a $16M equity-method loss (net of tax) is also included here so the flow lands on reported net income.

takeaways.title: Record sales of $3.2B
takeaways.text: Growth came from outside the car industry — Engineered Components rose 7% — while Intelligent Systems slipped 3% on soft vehicle production.

takeaways.title: Back to profit
takeaways.text: Net income of $194M compares with a $352M loss a year ago, when results absorbed a $648M goodwill impairment.

takeaways.title: Adjusted EPS of $1.42
takeaways.text: Excluding amortization and one-offs, Aptiv earned $1.42 a share versus $0.94 on a GAAP basis.

footerNote: Aptiv reports its equity-method result in two places — a $19M gain above the tax line and a $16M loss (net of tax) below it; both are folded into the other-expense line here so the flow reconciles to reported net income of $194M.
